compute_eigenvalues_and_eigenvectors: compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors for a batch of symmetric 3x3 matrices using symeig3x3
compute_eigenvalues_only: compute only eigenvalues for symmetric 3x3 matrices by setting eigenvectors to False in symeig3x3
create_rotation_matrices: create 3D rotation matrices around each coordinate axis by pi/2 using _create_rotation_matrices static method
construct_orthonormal_eigenvectors: construct an orthonormal set of eigenvectors from pre-computed eigenvalues using _construct_eigenvecs_set
sign_without_zero: compute a sign tensor that returns 1.0 for positive values and -1.0 otherwise using _sign_without_zero
